headline: SDP @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.30 at WSN 4.22, with a projected total of 8.52. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: SDP moved -1.19 runs while WSN moved -0.11, changing the projected margin by -1.08 runs. The projected total fell -1.30, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Zack Littell has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Fernando Tatis Jr., James Wood, Curtis Mead, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
